title: Job 25
paragraphs: ¹ Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said, ² Dominion and awe belong to God; he establishes peace in the heights of heaven. ³ Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not rise? ⁴ How then can a human being be righteous before God? How can anyone born of a woman be pure? ⁵ Even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his eyes —
⁶ how much less a human being, who is a maggot — a mortal, who is only a worm!
